in_marathi.name: Salil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Flow of Water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Salil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Salil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'salila', which means 'flow of water'. This name is associated with calmness, peace, and the tranquil flow of water. It is a beautiful name for a baby boy, and is often given to children born during the rainy season.
